content.text: {"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot \"accessory\" is for an item no other slot fits.", "\"is_outfit\" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following \"answer_schema\", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": ["\"description\" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Cream silk blouse with a relaxed fit and a subtle cowl neck, Ivory wool-blend wide-leg trousers in a fluid drape cut to mid-calf length, Charcoal textured wool trench coat falling just below the knee, Navy suede loafers with a low block heel. This ensemble embodies the requested neat business dress code for an autumn office day while adhering strictly to the refusal against outer layers in warm weather by providing only one necessary layer for potential chill. The soft cream and ivory tones create a calm, professional atmosphere suitable for daylight hours, while the textured fabrics add depth without sacrificing comfort or polish. The wide-leg trousers paired with sleek loafers offer an effortless yet refined silhouette that aligns perfectly with the \"neat\" category of the formality scale."}
